== Notes ==
* It costs a total of 200 Crimson Assassin Tokens to purchase the entire set of [[Crimson Assassin weapon skins]].
* You can double-click or right-click/use Token in your inventory to open a vendor window to buy the skins anywhere in Tyria.
* Takes multiple Super Adventure Festivals to complete. On average you can get 4-5 skins per festival.
* You can get one token per day from completing 3 daily achievements, 4 per week from [[(Weekly) Super Replay]] resetting every Monday, and another 8 as a choice from the [[Course Load]] achievement reward. This comes to around 2.5 tokens per day.
